MATERIAL IMPROVEMENT—RE-SOLVE

Three material improvements remain.

1. The headline is stale after the negative theorem. The TL;DR, project fill, technical limitation, and honest scope still call uniform split inference an "open" correction. The proved result instead says the proposed whole-array guarantee is false because M(D_gap) has no uniform rowwise stabilization. This changes the paper's headline and required remedy, not merely its wording.

2. The current note does not use Shi et al.'s published proximal synthetic-control class. Shi et al. assume consistency, an interactive fixed-effects model, existence of SC weights matching factor loadings, conditional proxy independence, and a stationary weakly dependent post residual; their inference theorem additionally invokes D.1-D.10, including ergodicity, domination, Jacobian convergence, positive-definite fixed-role moment covariance, comparable horizons, and full row rank. The note instead works with a reduced-form square unconditional bridge-moment class, geometric beta mixing, high moments, and possibly singular stacked covariance. Neither full class contains the other. Thus "strictly extends the fixed-role limit of Shi et al." is presently not a formal class-extension claim. See the anchor's Sections 3.1-3.2 and supplementary assumptions D.1-D.10 in arXiv:2108.13935.

The right repair is an inclusion witness, not wholesale restatement over Shi's broader nonstationary class. An iid, constant-treatment, one-factor Gaussian model with mutually conditionally independent treated, donor, and proxy noises is a stationary square subclass of Shi's hypotheses. Proving the conventional miscoverage and uniform-impossibility converse on that subclass transfers the converse upward to any larger published class containing it.

3. The negative bound is not sharp. In the existing diagonal construction, conditional on no Bernoulli successes—which has probability tending to one—the numerator is -q^(-2)+q^(-3) bar(xi)_q, while the centered Bartlett standard error is q^(-3)/sqrt(q){1+o_P(1)}. Hence T_q -> -infinity in probability, so the conditional Kolmogorov distance tends to its maximal value 1, not merely a liminf of 1/2. "Maximal Gaussian-approximation failure" is materially sharper.
